item.description:

item.title: Bill Gates and Silicon Valley congressman latest to endorse pope's AI encyclical
item.description:
![Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates arrives for a closed-door gathering of leading tech CEOs to discuss artificial intelligence and how it should be regulated, at Capitol Hill in Washington on Sept. 13, 2023. (AP/Jacquelyn Martin)](https://www.ncronline.org/files/2026-08/Senate_Artificial_Intelligence_23256528130677%20RESIZE.jpg)
Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates arrives for a closed-door gathering of leading tech CEOs to discuss artificial intelligence and how it should be regulated, at Capitol Hill in Washington on Sept.
### [Join the Conversation](https://www.ncronline.org/join-conversation) Shortly after the release of Pope Leo XIV's landmark encyclical on artificial intelligence, _Magnifica Humanitas_, a leading AI expert expressed skepticism over the document's ability to effect concrete change around regulation of the tech industry.
Elham Tabassi, director of the Brookings Institution's Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technology Initiative, [said](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/understanding-pope-leos-ai-encyclical/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) on the encyclical: "I don't think that this is going to be a driver for any sort of legislation or anything," though she maintained that the document could still influence important conversations around AI.
"Artificial intelligence should strengthen human judgment, creativity, and wisdom, not seek to replace them."

item.title: University of Chicago Launches New Master’s in Applied Artificial Intelligence | Newswise
item.description:
# University of Chicago Launches New Master’s in Applied Artificial Intelligence ###### _New nine-month program prepares technically experienced students to move beyond AI fundamentals and build, deploy, and lead with emerging technologies._ Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing how organizations build products, make decisions, and create value.
## **Moving Beyond the Fundamentals** Students complete four [core courses](https://datascience.uchicago.edu/education/masters-programs/masters-in-applied-artificial-intelligence/applied-ai-curriculum/) spanning AI foundations and principles; advanced architectures and applications; AI security, safety, and governance; and value creation and leadership with AI.
From there, students choose five electives organized across three focus areas: AI in Practice, Frontier AI, and Performance AI.

item.title: ‘It’s all about the tension’: Upcoming artificial intelligence summit to explore uncomfortable issues
item.description:
# 'It’s all about the tension'; Upcoming artificial intelligence summit to explore uncomfortable issues Artificial intelligence has shaken up the status quo, stirring up questions both logistical and existential — and Pittsburgh’s third annual AI Horizons summit promises to tackle those questions head on.
One session will tackle how to make Pittsburgh an AI-powered city, from its decision-making to its infrastructure, putting Jumbi Edulbehram, head of Global Business Development, Smart Cities and Spaces at NVIDIA in conversation with Pittsburgh Mayor Corey O’Connor.
On day two, students and teachers will help launch a new initiative called Pennsylvania Creates which aims to make the next generation not mere consumers, but creators and honers of AI.
AI Horizons is not only to brainstorm how to thrive through AI, “future-proof” our economy and encourage corporations to leverage the city’s talent, Doven said.
